manifest.test_set_note: 32 prospective complete fictional claim reports, eight per registered marker. Shared claim identities and all stated times/proof/checker references remain explicit. This measures no comprehension, factual truth of real proof, checker trustworthiness, or future trained-model performance. The eight reference substitutions are not eight independent semantic populations. Conjunction and expiry decision interactions are for the separate reader study.
